english.title: Promote cycle race on public way
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) promoted a race or trial of speed between cycles on a public way, namely **(..SPECIFY PUBLIC WAY AND LOCATION..), which was not

(A)_[authorised]_
(B)_[conducted in accordance with conditions imposed]_

by or under the Cycle Racing on Highways Regulations 1960.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) In the Statement of Facts give details of the nature of the promotion and details of any danger caused to other road users.
